text: dsh-macos-notify 是面向 macOS 上 DeepSeek Harness 的通知插件，在 agent 轮次结束或权限请求到达时调用系统通知中心显示横幅。它通过 /usr/bin/osascript 发送通知，并提供网页端独立的“通知”设置页。用户可为完成、受阻、取消、失败、达到 token 上限、中断和权限请求分别选择系统提示音并编辑标题与内容，也能设置是否通知以及是否忽略子 agent。适合希望离开终端时仍能留意任务状态的 macOS 用户；需要 macOS 和 DSH 配置，不需要额外 API 密钥。

dsh-macos-notify adds macOS notification banners for DSH agent turn endings and approval requests. Its web settings page lets users choose sounds and edit messages for each outcome, preview banners, and skip delegated sessions. It requires macOS and /usr/bin/osascript; no API key is needed.
想让 macOS 在 DSH 任务结束时弹出系统通知。
权限请求来了以后，能不能用通知横幅提醒我？
我离开电脑时也想知道 agent 是完成、失败还是卡住了。
让每种任务结果都能单独设置提醒声音和通知文字。
How can I get native macOS alerts when a DSH agent finishes or needs approval?
I want to customize notification sounds and messages for different agent outcomes.
dsh-macos-notify 的功能「通知 agent 轮次结果」：插件监听 turn/end 事件，并按完成、受阻、取消、错误、token 上限或中断选择对应标题、正文和提示音，再显示 macOS 通知横幅。
dsh-macos-notify 的功能「权限请求提醒」：当 approval/request 到达时，插件可显示带工具名和请求原因的通知，同时继续交给后续审批处理器。
dsh-macos-notify 的功能「按事件自定义通知」：网页通知设置页可分别选择每类事件的 macOS 提示音、编辑标题和正文、预览效果，并保存或恢复默认值。
dsh-macos-notify 的功能「控制通知范围」：设置页提供轮次结束、权限请求和仅顶层会话三个开关；启用仅顶层时会跳过委派子 agent 的会话。
dsh-macos-notify 仅支持 macOS；加载时会检查平台，并依赖系统自带的 /usr/bin/osascript 发送通知。
DSH 能不能在 agent 需要我批准时主动提醒？
我想给任务完成和报错设置不同的 macOS 提示音。

一个面向 macOS 的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：当 agent（智能体）轮次结束，或权限请求需要你处理时，通过 `/usr/bin/osascript` 弹出原生通知中心横幅；同时提供独立的 **通知** 设置页，让每一种触发操作各自配置提示音、标题与内容。

本包分为两半：Host 半声明可实时编辑的 Cordis 配置并监听 agent 事件；浏览器半贡献一个 **通知** 设置分区（section），通过共享的 `ctx.configForms` 服务编辑本插件在 profile 里的配置项。把本包同时挂载到两个平面就是全部接线——页面写的是同一个 profile 条目，Host 直接在运行中的 volatile 引用上读到新值，两半互不知道对方的代码。
dsh-macos-notify README · dsh-macos-notify：本版本对应 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1；`package.json` 用 `engines.dsh` 声明兼容范围，安装和 profile 启动都会检查。

dsh-macos-notify README · 触发操作、提示音与文本：| 操作 | 事件 | 默认提示音 | 默认标题 | 默认内容 | 设置项 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 轮次完成 | `session/event` → `turn/end`（`completed`） | Glass | `Task completed` | `The agent finished its turn.` | `sounds.completed`、`messages.completed` |
| 轮次受阻 | `turn/end`（`blocked`） | Funk | `Task blocked` | `The agent could not proceed.` | `sounds.blocked`、`messages.blocked` |
| 轮次取消 | `turn/end`（`aborted`） | Basso | `Task cancelled` | `The agent was cancelled.` | `sounds.aborted`、`messages.aborted` |
| 轮次失败 | `turn/end`（`error`） | Basso | `Task failed` | `{error}` | `sounds.error`、`messages.error` |
| 达到 token 上限 | `turn/end`（`max-tokens`） | Funk | `Token limit reached` | `The agent hit the output token ceiling.` | `sounds.maxTokens`、`messages.maxTokens` |
| 轮次中断 | `turn/end`（`interrupted`） | Basso | `Turn interrupted` | `The turn was interrupted.` | `sounds.interrupted`、`messages.interrupted` |
| 权限请求 | `approval/request` | Ping | `Permission requested` | `{tool} needs {reason}` | `sounds.approval`、`messages.approval` |

text:
dsh-macos-notify README · 触发操作、提示音与文本：本插件不认识的、由其他插件合并扩展出来的轮次结束原因，会退化为“轮次完成”这一项——沿用它的提示音与文本。

可选提示音就是 macOS 系统提示音——`Basso`、`Blow`、`Bottle`、`Frog`、`Funk`、`Glass`、`Hero`、`Morse`、`Ping`、`Pop`、`Purr`、`Sosumi`、`Submarine`、`Tink`——外加 `default`（你在系统中配置的提醒声音）与 `none`（静音横幅，完全不生成 sound 子句）。

text:
dsh-macos-notify README · 可用变量：标题与内容可以使用该操作暴露的变量；其他内容（包括写错的变量名）原样出现在横幅里，因此拼错时你能一眼看见，而不会让整句话消失。

| 操作 | 变量 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| 所有轮次结束操作 | `{turn}` | 已关闭轮次的编号。 |
| 轮次取消 | `{cause}` | 取消原因类型（`user` 等）。 |
| 轮次失败 | `{error}` | 失败信息。 |
| 权限请求 | `{tool}` | 需要授权的工具名。 |
| 权限请求 | `{reason}` | 询问方给出的原因；没有时替换为单词 `approval`。 |

`{error}` 与 `{reason}` 在代入前已按上限截断，最终渲染出的标题与内容也各自限制在 160 个字符以内——这正是横幅能显示的长度。

dsh-macos-notify README · 从 GitHub 仓库安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WShihan/dsh-macos-notify
```

本仓库把构建产物 `lib/` 一并纳入版本管理，因此安装过程中没有任何构建步骤：pnpm 找不到安装脚本，不会要求任何构建放行，下次重启 `dsh web` 即可加载。若希望安装固定在你审阅过的那个版本，就锁定提交：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WShihan/dsh-macos-notify#<sha>
```

以后更新用同样的命令，或 `dsh plugin --profile web update dsh-macos-notify`。

要改动本插件时，则是克隆下来在本地构建：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/WShihan/dsh-macos-notify
cd dsh-macos-notify
pnpm install
pnpm run build

dsh-macos-notify README · 从 npm 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-macos-notify
```

这种方式要求本包已发布到 registry。`pnpm pack` 会把同样这份已提交的 `lib/` 打成可安装的 tarball：

```sh
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-macos-notify-0.2.0.tgz
```

dsh-macos-notify README · 从本地目录安装：```sh
pnpm run build     # 在插件目录内执行，确保 lib/ 存在
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/macos-notify
```

本地目录会以 `link:` 方式安装，而 pnpm 不会为它构建、也不会安装它的依赖，所以请先构建。Host 半是自包含的——除相对模块外，它唯一的运行时导入是 schema 库，构建时会内联——因此即使 profile 的包不在这条解析路径上，被链接的目录也能正常加载。

被链接的目录是由 `lib/` 提供服务的，因此每次改源码都要重新构建并重启服务：

```sh
cd /absolute/path/to/macos-notify
pnpm run dev          # tsdown --watch：保存即重建 lib/

dsh-macos-notify README · 然后重启 dsh web，并刷新页面：```

`dsh web` 在启动时导入 `lib/index.js`，并把 `lib/client.js` 快照进对外提供的启动图（boot graph），所以只重建而不重启是看不到效果的；刷新页面才会加载新的启动图。改设置则完全不需要这些——在「通知」页改的值由 Loader 提交进运行中的配置引用，下一条横幅立即生效。被链接的目录始终提供它自己的 `lib/`，所以请把重建后的文件与源码改动一起提交（见[已提交的构建产物](#已提交的构建产物)）。

如果安装输出 `declares no dsh.bundle … installed as a plain dependency`，说明加进去的是另一个包，或是没有该清单的检出目录。请先移除它，再添加本目录。

dsh-macos-notify README · 在 deepseek-harness 检出目录内使用：用一个 patch 覆盖层指向构建后的入口：

```yaml
- id: macos-notify
  name: 'file:///absolute/path/to/deepseek-harness/macos-notify/lib/index.js'
```

`id` 不能省：它既是配置命名空间，也是设置页寻址本插件表单所用的键。

请把构建后的插件挂载到运行构建产物的 harness 上。以源码方式启动（`tsx`）的 harness 会从源码解析 `@deepseek-ai/*`，此时构建后的插件会加载第二个 Cordis 实例；请先构建 harness（`pnpm run build`）。

text:
dsh-macos-notify README · 从 0.1.x 升级：DSH 0.2.1 取消了独立的设置文档：设置页现在直接编辑 profile 中本插件条目的 `config`，字段名与 0.1.x 相同。旧版本的 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` 会被 DSH 一次性导入并改名为 `settings.yaml.imported`；如果导入发生时本插件尚未加载（例如它正因为版本不兼容而无法启动），其中 `macos-notify` 这一节会留在该文件里，而没有写进 profile。此时把它手工迁到 profile 覆盖层即可：

```yaml

dsh-macos-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: macos-notify
  config:
    sounds:
      completed: Funk
    messages:
      completed:
        title: DSH 本轮完成
        message: 第{turn}轮任务完成。
```

旧的 `macos-notify-preview` 一节只是当时的预览通道，直接忽略。`engines.dsh` 会拒绝 0.2.1 之前的运行时，因此升级 DSH 后必须同时升级本插件。

设置页写入的是 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，与插件包本身无关：之后用 `dsh plugin update` / 重新 `add` 升级本插件，都不会改动你迁移进去的旧配置。只有重置 profile（例如 `--from-default-profile`）才会清掉它；届时把上面的 `- id: macos-notify` 块重新贴回去即可。

dsh-macos-notify README · 设置页：在插件已挂载、并且组合了设置服务（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`，随 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 一起提供）时，设置面板会多出一个独立的 **通知** 页，在导航里排在通用、模型、插件、Agent 预设之后：

- **通知时机** 分组：轮次结束时通知、权限请求时通知、仅通知我自己的会话三个开关；
- **轮次结束横幅** 与 **权限请求横幅** 两个分组：上表每一种操作一个区块，内含该操作的提示音下拉框、标题、内容、**测试** 按钮；一旦你的 profile 覆盖层带有其中任一字段，就多出一个 **恢复默认** 按钮。

提示音与开关在选择时立即提交；文本则先暂存，由 **保存** 一次性写入（**放弃** 丢弃暂存）。因为一次设置写入就是一次持久化文档改动，若逐字符提交就会存入你并未确认的修改。所有改动的下一条横幅立即生效，无需重启。只有在 Host 对外提供 `macos-notify` 条目时页面才会渲染控件；没有设置服务时，下面的组合配置仍是唯一来源，页面为空。

dsh-macos-notify README · 测试横幅：**测试** 会立刻发出该操作的横幅，让你在真正等待某个轮次之前就能判断提示音与措辞是否合适。它预览的是页面上当前的文本——包括尚未保存的修改——并把该操作的变量替换为示例值（`{turn}` → `1`、`{tool}` → `shell`、`{error}` → `出了点问题。` 等）。测试不会保存文本，也不会改变已存储的提示音与措辞。

预览请求借道本插件配置里一个瞬态的 `preview` 字段（见[设计说明](#设计说明)）：页面写入后 Host 立即发出横幅并清除该请求；单调递增的 `nonce` 保证残留或重复的请求不会被重复触发。这个字段属于管道而非配置，正常情况下它不会留在 profile 里。

本插件的配置项拥有自己的页面，因此 Host 会关闭自动生成的配置页（`settings.configure({ auto: false })`），它不会在 **设置 → 插件** 里再出现一张重复的卡片。

dsh-macos-notify README · 组合配置（`cordis.yml`）：每个字段都可省略；设置页写入的 profile 覆盖层优先级高于它。

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `notifyOnTurnEnd` | `true` | 每个关闭的 agent 轮次弹出一条通知。 |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | 审批请求到达应答链时弹出通知。 |
| `topLevelOnly` | `true` | 跳过委托子 agent（`delegationDepth > 0`）所属的会话；用户分叉出的会话仍视为顶层。 |
| `sounds.completed` … `sounds.approval` | 见上表 | 每种操作的提示音。未知名称会在加载时明确失败，作为设置写入也会被拒绝。 |
| `messages.<操作>.title` | 见上表 | 横幅标题。`sounds` 下的每一种操作在这里都有对应项。 |
| `messages.<操作>.message` | 见上表 | 横幅内容；横幅触发时会代入上表的可用变量。 |

- id: macos-notify
  name: dsh-macos-notify
  config:

dsh-macos-notify README · 已提交的构建产物：本仓库把 `lib/` 纳入版本管理，而不是在安装时生成。`lib/index.js` 是 Loader 导入的入口，`lib/client.js` 是客户端模块系统对外提供的包体——正是因为它们被提交，`dsh plugin add github:WShihan/dsh-macos-notify` 才能在没有安装脚本、也不需要 pnpm 构建放行的情况下装好。

改动本插件的人都要遵守这份约定：

dsh-macos-notify README · 已提交的构建产物：- **重建与提交成对出现。** 任何 `src/` 下的改动之后，先跑 `pnpm run build`，并在同一次提交里带上重新生成的 `lib/`。仓库对外提供的就是 `lib/` 里的内容，只改源码而落下 `lib/` 等于发布旧代码。
- **不要手改 `lib/`。** 它是生成产物：改 `src/`，再重建。
- **本包不声明 `prepare` 或 `postinstall` 脚本。** 这是有意为之，也是 git 安装不需要 `allowBuilds` 的原因。新克隆下来就已经带着提交好的 `lib/`；只有在改过源码之后才需要 `pnpm run build`。
- **在本包自己的仓库里提交。** 开发期间本包位于 deepseek-harness 检出目录内，而该检出根部的 `.gitignore` 会排除 `lib/`；git 采用最外层的那份配置，嵌套的 `.gitignore` 也无法把被父级排除的目录重新纳入。请先把本包复制到它自己的仓库，或在检出目录内提交产物时用 `git add -f lib`。
- **评审看 `src/`，不看 `lib/`。** 打包产物的 diff 是生成出来的、又很大；即使跳过它，也要确认这次提交里带着重建后的副本——下面的 `pnpm run check` 顺序正是保证这一点的做法。
- **发布的就是已提交的内容。** `pnpm pack` 与 `npm publish` 原样上传当前的 `lib/`，所以发布前请先构建。

dsh-macos-notify README · 构建、测试、检查：```sh
pnpm install       # 安装工具链与类型包
pnpm run build     # tsdown → lib/index.js（Host）+ lib/client.js（浏览器）
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run test      # vitest：Host 监听器、设置接线、页面模型、页面渲染

提交前请跑一次 `pnpm run check`：它会重新构建 `lib/`，因此你提交的产物正是测试跑过的那一份。

dsh-macos-notify README · 构建、测试、检查：`vitest.config.ts` 会在两种布局下寻找 harness 检出：本包位于 `<harness>/plugins/macos-notify`，或与本包同级（例如 `<parent>/deepseek-harness`）。找到时把 `@deepseek-ai/*` 别名到该 workspace 源码，直接跑 `pnpm run test` 无需先构建 harness；两种布局都不存在时，测试使用 `node_modules` 里已发布的包，因此独立克隆也能通过。`tsconfig.json` 始终解析已安装包发布的声明文件，所以 typecheck 只要求 `pnpm install` 成功。

dsh-macos-notify README · 页面没有出现：1. **插件行已挂载。** `dsh plugin --profile web add …` 不应输出 `declares no dsh.bundle`；`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 里能看到 `# == dsh-macos-notify` 层和 `- id: macos-notify` 行。
2. **`lib/` 是最新的。** profile 提供的是构建后的 `lib/client.js`——来自本仓库已提交的那份，或来自你自己的重建；改了源码却没跑 `pnpm run build`（也没重启）等于没改。
3. **重启后刷新过页面。** 启动图（boot graph）注入在首页响应里，已打开的标签页会一直用旧图。
4. **组合了设置服务。** 页面的控件通过 `ctx.configForms` 读写 `macos-notify` 条目，而这需要 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`（行 id `settings`）随 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 一起提供，因此 `web` profile 默认就有。导航行本身与条目是否就绪无关，只有控件会等待它。
5. **在设置导航里找“通知”这一行。** 它是一个独立分区，排在通用、模型、插件、Agent 预设之后，不是插件页里的卡片。

dsh-macos-notify README · 设计说明：- **横幅走受管子进程 seam。** 每条横幅都是一次 `ctx.subprocess.spawn`，执行 `/usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification …'`；卸载时会终止仍在运行的横幅，通知也永远不会阻塞触发它的事件。启动失败或非零退出只写入警告日志，不会到达模型。
- **AppleScript 字面量，而非 shell。** 标题与消息按 AppleScript 字符串字面量转义（JSON 的 `\"`/`\\` 子集，控制字符替换为空格），并作为单个 `-e` 参数传入，任何消息内容都不会被 shell 解释。
- **只观察，不裁决。** `session/event` 监听器只读取 `turn/end` 的原因；`approval/request` waterfall 监听器总是用 `next()` 委托，因此永远不会替人做审批决定。`'never'` 审批策略会在进入应答链之前短路，确定性拒绝不会产生横幅。
- **实时事件，而非回放。** `session/event` 只广播实时追加，因此重载或恢复会话不会引发横幅风暴。
- **实时配置引用，而非重挂载。** 所有可编辑字段都声明为 `.volatile()`；Loader 在一次设置写入后把新值提交进稳定的引用并发出 `loader/volatile-update`，插件实例、监听器与在途横幅都不受影响。每个监听器在触发时读取 `.get()`，这正是设置页改动能对下一条横幅立即生效的原因。
- **设置页编辑的是 profile 条目本身。** 页面通过共享的 `ctx.configForms`（按 profile 条目 id 寻址）做带 revision 围栏、经完整 Config 校验的写入；持久化落在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，不再有独立的 `settings.yaml`。
- **文本是模板，不是格式化字符串。** `{名称}` 就是全部语法：触发操作暴露的值会替换同名变量，其余字符——包括写错的变量名——原样进入横幅。
- **测试按钮借道配置文档。** 插件的浏览器半只能通过生成出来的 remote 命名空间触达 Host，而本包发布在那一套装配之外，因此两半唯一共有的通道就是配置。测试把一个 `preview` 对象写进本插件的 profile 条目，Loader 提交后 Host 读取它、发出横幅并清除该字段；每个请求里单调递增的 `nonce` 保证残留或重复的请求不会被重复触发。这个字段只是管道而非配置：上表不记录它，正常情况下它是空的。
- **浏览器半只有一个 lazy-CJS 包。** `lib/client.js`

dsh-macos-notify README · 已知限制：- **仅支持 macOS。** 在其他平台挂载会在加载时抛错，而不是静默丢弃通知；也没有跨平台回退方案。
- **通知的归属方是“脚本编辑器”。** `osascript` 以脚本宿主身份投递横幅，因此 macOS 在“系统设置 → 通知”里把它列在 **脚本编辑器** 下。需要在那里允许该应用，否则横幅会被隐藏，而脚本仍然正常退出。
- **即发即弃。** 失败的横幅只记日志并丢弃：没有重试、没有队列，系统抑制通知时也没有应用内兜底。
- **没有节流。** 每个轮次、每次审批请求各一条横幅；长会话就是每轮一条，没有任何合并。
- **轮次即任务单位。** harness 没有持久的“任务”记录，因此“任务完成”指的是一个 agent 轮次关闭。
- **标题与内容各限 160 个字符。** 超出（无论是配置的还是代入后的）都会以 `…` 截断，因为通知中心本来就会裁剪。
- **暂存的文本只存在于当前页面。** 带着未保存的修改离开设置页就会丢弃它们；提示音与开关是立即提交的，不受影响。
- **页面与测试需要设置服务。** 两者都经 `ctx.configForms` 传递，因此没有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 的部署没有页面控件，也没有测试按钮；轮次结束与审批横幅本身不受影响。
- **配置写入会固定整条配置。** profile 的 patch 以整条 `config` 为单位，因此页面第一次写入后，该条目的所有 volatile 字段都会出现在 profile 覆盖层里；这是 DSH 0.2.1 配置编辑器的既有语义。

Source, issues, and releases: <https://github.com/WShihan/dsh-macos-notify>.

A DeepSeek Harness plugin for macOS: it shows a native Notification Center banner through `/usr/bin/osascript` when an agent turn ends or when a permission request reaches you, and it ships a **Notifications** settings page where every one of those operations gets its own alert sound, title, and body.

dsh-macos-notify README · dsh-macos-notify：The package has two halves. The Host half declares live-editable Cordis configuration and listens to agent events; the browser half contributes a **Notifications** settings section that edits the plugin's profile entry through the shared `ctx.configForms` service. Mounting the package on both planes is the whole wiring — the page writes the same profile entry the Host reads through volatile references, so neither half knows the other's code.

dsh-macos-notify README · dsh-macos-notify：This release targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1; `package.json` declares the compatible range under `engines.dsh`, which installation and profile startup both check.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Turn completed | `session/event` → `turn/end` (`completed`) | Glass | `Task completed` | `The agent finished its turn.` | `sounds.completed`, `messages.completed` |
| Turn blocked | `turn/end` (`blocked`) | Funk | `Task blocked` | `The agent could not proceed.` | `sounds.blocked`, `messages.blocked` |
| Turn cancelled | `turn/end` (`aborted`) | Basso | `Task cancelled` | `The agent was cancelled.` | `sounds.aborted`, `messages.aborted` |
| Turn failed | `turn/end` (`error`) | Basso | `Task failed` | `{error}` | `sounds.error`, `messages.error` |
| Token limit reached | `turn/end` (`max-tokens`) | Funk | `Token limit reached` | `The agent hit the output token ceiling.` | `sounds.maxTokens`, `messages.maxTokens` |
| Turn interrupted | `turn/end` (`interrupted`) | Basso | `Turn interrupted` | `The turn was interrupted.` | `sounds.interrupted`, `messages.interrupted` |
| Permission requested | `approval/request` | Ping | `Permission requested` | `{tool} needs {reason}` | `sounds.approval`, `messages.approval` |

dsh-macos-notify README · Triggers, sounds, and text：A merge-extended turn-end reason this plugin does not know about falls through to the completed operation — its sound and its text.

Sounds are the macOS system alert sounds — `Basso`, `Blow`, `Bottle`, `Frog`, `Funk`, `Glass`, `Hero`, `Morse`, `Ping`, `Pop`, `Purr`, `Sosumi`, `Submarine`, `Tink` — plus `default` (your configured alert sound) and `none` (silent banner, no sound clause at all).

dsh-macos-notify README · Placeholders：A title or body may use the placeholders its operation exposes; anything else stays in the text verbatim, so a typo shows up in the banner instead of erasing the sentence around it.

dsh-macos-notify README · Placeholders：| Operation | Placeholders | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Every turn-end operation | `{turn}` | The closed turn's number. |
| Turn cancelled | `{cause}` | Cancellation cause kind (`user`, …). |
| Turn failed | `{error}` | The failure message. |
| Permission requested | `{tool}` | The tool that needs approval. |
| Permission requested | `{reason}` | The asker's reason, or the word `approval` when it gave none. |
dsh-macos-notify README · Placeholders：`{error}` and `{reason}` are substituted already bounded, and the rendered title and body are each capped at 160 characters, which is what a banner shows.

dsh-macos-notify README · Upgrading from 0.1.x：DSH 0.2.1 removed the separate settings document: the page now edits the `config` of this plugin's profile entry directly, with the same field names as 0.1.x. DSH imports the old `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml` once and renames it to `settings.yaml.imported`; if this plugin was not loaded when that happened (for example because it could not start on the new release), its `macos-notify` section stays in that file instead of reaching the profile. Move it into the profile override by hand:

```yaml

dsh-macos-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: macos-notify
  config:
    sounds:
      completed: Funk
    messages:
      completed:
        title: Turn finished
        message: 'Turn {turn} is done.'
```

The old `macos-notify-preview` section was only that era's preview channel; ignore it. `engines.dsh` refuses runtimes before 0.2.1, so upgrading DSH requires upgrading this plugin too.

dsh-macos-notify README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：The settings page writes the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, not the plugin package: upgrading this plugin with `dsh plugin update` or another `add` never touches the migrated configuration. Only resetting the profile (for example with `--from-default-profile`) clears it; paste the `- id: macos-notify` block back in that case.

dsh-macos-notify README · Settings page：With this plugin mounted and a settings service composed (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings`, which ships in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`), the settings panel gains a **Notifications** page of its own, listed in the navigation after General, Models, Plugins, and Agent presets:

dsh-macos-notify README · Settings page：- a **When to notify** group with switches for turn-end notifications, permission-request notifications, and "only my own sessions";
- a **Turn-end banners** group and a **Permission banner** group, one block per operation in the table above, each holding that operation's sound select, title, and body, a **Test** button, and a **Reset to default** button once your profile override carries any of them.

dsh-macos-notify README · Settings page：Sound and switches commit as you pick them; text is staged and written by **Save** (or dropped by **Discard**), because a settings write is a durable document mutation and committing per keystroke would store edits you never asked for. Every change applies to the next banner — no restart. The page renders its controls only while the Host serves the `macos-notify` entry; without a settings service the composition entry below is the only source and the page renders empty.

dsh-macos-notify README · Testing a banner：**Test** sends that operation's banner immediately, so you can judge the sound and the wording before anyone waits on a real turn. It previews the text as it currently reads on the page — including edits you have not saved — with the operation's placeholders replaced by samples (`{turn}` → `1`, `{tool}` → `shell`, `{error}` → `Something went wrong.`, and so on). Testing saves no text and changes no stored sound or wording.

dsh-macos-notify README · Testing a banner：The preview request rides a transient `preview` field in this plugin's own configuration entry (see [Design notes](#design-notes)): the page writes it, the Host fires the banner and clears the request immediately, and the monotonic `nonce` keeps a leftover or repeated request from firing twice. That field is plumbing, not configuration, and normally never stays in the profile.

dsh-macos-notify README · Testing a banner：Because this plugin's configuration owns a page, the Host turns the automatic schema page off (`settings.configure({ auto: false })`), so it contributes no duplicate card under **Settings → Plugins**.

dsh-macos-notify README · Committed build output：`lib/` is versioned in this repository rather than generated at install time. `lib/index.js` is what the Loader imports and `lib/client.js` is what the client module system serves, so committing them is exactly what lets `dsh plugin add github:WShihan/dsh-macos-notify` work with no install script and no pnpm build allowance.

Anyone changing the plugin is bound by that contract:

dsh-macos-notify README · Committed build output：- **Rebuild and commit together.** After any change under `src/`, run `pnpm run build` and commit the regenerated `lib/` in the same commit. The repository serves whatever `lib/` holds, so a source change that leaves `lib/` behind ships stale code.
- **Never hand-edit `lib/`.** It is generated output: edit `src/` and rebuild.
- **The package declares no `prepare` or `postinstall` script.** That is deliberate, and it is why a git install needs no `allowBuilds` entry. A fresh clone already has the committed `lib/`; run `pnpm run build` only after editing sources.
- **Commit from the package's own repository.** During development this package sits inside a deepseek-harness checkout, whose root `.gitignore` excludes `lib/`; git applies the outermost file, and a nested `.gitignore` cannot re-include a directory its parent excluded. Copy the package into its own repository first, or `git add -f lib` if you are committing artifacts from inside the checkout.
- **Review `src/`, not `lib/`.** The bundle diff is generated and large; a review that skips it still has to confirm the commit carries a rebuilt copy, and the `pnpm run check` ordering

pnpm install       # installs the toolchain and type packages
pnpm run build     # tsdown → lib/index.js (Host) + lib/client.js (browser)
pnpm run typecheck

Run `pnpm run check` before committing: it rebuilds `lib/`, so the artifacts you commit are the ones the tests exercised.

dsh-macos-notify README · Build, test, check：`vitest.config.ts` looks for a harness checkout in two layouts: this package inside `<harness>/plugins/macos-notify`, or beside `<harness>` (for example `<parent>/deepseek-harness`). When one is found it aliases `@deepseek-ai/*` to that workspace's sources, so `pnpm run test` needs no harness build; with neither layout the tests use the published packages in `node_modules`, so a standalone clone passes too. `tsconfig.json` always resolves the installed packages' published declarations, so typechecking only needs a successful `pnpm install`.

dsh-macos-notify README · The page does not appear：1. **The plugin row is mounted.** `dsh plugin --profile web add …` must not print `declares no dsh.bundle`; `dsh --profile web --dump-config` shows a `# == dsh-macos-notify` layer with an `- id: macos-notify` row.
2. **`lib/` is current.** The profile serves the built `lib/client.js`, from this repository's committed copy or from your rebuild; a source edit without `pnpm run build` (and a restart) changes nothing.
3. **The page was reloaded after a restart.** The boot graph is injected into the index response, so an open tab keeps the old graph until it is refreshed.
4. **A settings service is composed.** The page's controls read and write the `macos-notify` entry through `ctx.configForms`, which needs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` (row id `settings`); it ships in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, so a `web` profile has it by default. The navigation row appears either way; only its controls wait for the entry.
5. **Look for the Notifications row in the settings navigation.** The page is its own section, listed after General, Models, Plugins, and Agent presets — not a card inside Plugins.

dsh-macos-notify README · Design notes：- **Banners ride the managed subprocess seam.** Each banner is one `ctx.subprocess.spawn` of `/usr/bin/osascript -e 'display notification …'`; teardown terminates banners still running, and the notification never blocks the event that triggered it. A failed spawn or a non-zero exit is logged as a warning and never reaches the model.
- **AppleScript literals, not shell.** Title and message are escaped as AppleScript string literals (JSON's `\"`/`\\` subset; control characters become spaces) and passed as a single `-e` argument, so no message content is ever shell-interpreted.
- **Observe, never decide.** The `session/event` listener only reads the `turn/end` reason, and the `approval/request` waterfall listener always delegates with `next()`, so it can never claim an approval decision. The `'never'` approval policy short-circuits before the answerer chain, so deterministic rejections produce no banner.
- **Live events, not replay.** `session/event` broadcasts live appends only, so reloading or resuming a session never replays a banner storm.
- **Live configuration references, no remount.** Every editable field is declared `.volatile()`; after a

dsh-macos-notify README · Known limitations：- **macOS only.** Mounting the plugin on another platform throws at load rather than silently dropping notifications, and there is no cross-platform fallback.
- **Notifications are attributed to Script Editor.** `osascript` posts the banner as the scripting host, so macOS lists it under **Script Editor** in System Settings → Notifications. Allow that app there, or banners stay hidden while the script still exits successfully.
- **Fire-and-forget delivery.** A failed banner is logged and dropped: no retry, no queue, and no in-app fallback when the system suppresses notifications.
- **No throttling.** One banner per turn and per approval request; a long session produces one banner per turn, batched by nothing.
- **Turn is the task unit.** The harness has no durable "task" record, so "task completed" means one agent turn closed.
- **A banner field is capped at 160 characters.** A longer title or body — configured or substituted — is elided with `…`, because Notification Center clips it anyway.
- **Staged text lives only in the open page.** Leaving the settings page with unsaved edits drops them; sounds and switches, which commit immediately,

dsh-macos-notify README · Renaming the package：The package name appears in exactly three places: `"name"` in `package.json`, the `ID` constant in `tsdown.config.ts` (the module-loader id stamped into `lib/client.js`), and the `name` of the row in `cordis.patch.yml`. Rename all three together; the configuration namespace (`macos-notify`) is the `id` of that row and is independent of the package name, so it may stay as it is. `SETTINGS_NAMESPACE` in `src/settings.ts` must match that `id`, or the browser half cannot find its form.
dsh-macos-notify README · Model Experience：None. The plugin observes live agent events, sends nothing to the model, and registers no prompt, tool schema, or context.
dsh-macos-notify README · KV Cache effect：It adds no model-visible content, so it neither grows nor invalidates the request prefix.
